nodes.label: Simulation episode retention — 2026-11-14
nodes.status: Selective retention completed; no new controller experiment or outcome revision

nodes.label: 2026-11-14 selective simulation retention
nodes.summary: Freed 3.372 GiB; approximately 25.88 GiB free afterward. Deleted 36 large raw files from 12 QC/outcome-verified successful evaluation rollouts, retaining native traces and evidence. Kept six representative B0/20k successes (slots 1,2,5,6,10,17), all five task failures and one startup unknown. Compressed 206 historical Common103 diagnostic/environment traces losslessly. Existing Goal100 10k/15k/20k models/replay, training evidence, qualification, real data and source/config retained.
nodes.rationale: Preserve reproducible checkpoints rather than deleting models based on one small pilot. Remaining raw is a chosen diagnostic set, not a random sample for success-rate estimation.

nodes.label: Historical Common training trace review
nodes.summary: Re-read 88,859 transitions and 632 completed episodes across five historical Common job traces, including unfinished tails. Checked strictly increasing timesteps, finite rewards and reward-component sums. Job segments contain respectively 149, 71, 142, 71 and 199 complete episodes; old-contract successes are 139, 62, 142, 71 and 176.
nodes.rationale: These may share seeds/checkpoint ancestry and are not five independent training seeds. Changing-policy scheduled-stop success is not frozen evaluation or unknown-step Goal100 success; valid trace arithmetic does not repair failed jobs.

nodes.label: Retained-evidence verification and recovery limits
nodes.summary: Before cleanup, recomputed 3,648 decisions over 23 valid evaluations against the ledger and verified all 789 original manifest files. After cleanup, 3,974 protected files and 753 remaining original-manifest evaluation files matched hashes; exactly 36 raw files are intentionally absent and receipted. All 206 archives were fully decompressed and hash/byte-checked before unlink. GUI review, qualification and checkpoint readiness still passed. Use verify_retained.py with manifest plus receipt.
nodes.rationale: Deleted successful raw cannot be fully reread; native decision traces cannot reconstruct 500 Hz sensor sources. Retained-set verification is not a pass for the original complete raw archive. Original manifests, ledgers, job statuses and research decision remain unchanged.
